question: List every client's id and full name together with the name of their agency.
reply:
```sql
SELECT 
    [client].[client_id], 
    [client].[full_name], 
    [agency].[name] AS [agency_name]
FROM 
    [people].[client] AS [client]
JOIN 
    [org].[agency] AS [agency] ON [client].[agency_id] = [agency].[agency_id];
```
